semiconductor_relevance: High — Hantop Intelligence Tech. specializes in ultrasonic-assisted machining technology that enhances processing efficiency and tool life for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Hantop Intelligence Tech. (HIT) provides advanced ultrasonic-assisted machining modules designed for high-precision processing of hard-to-cut materials in the semiconductor industry. Their technology significantly improves tool life and processing efficiency, making it suitable for applications in semiconductor fabrication, particularly for components like showerheads and wafer susceptors.
capabilities: Ultrasonic-assisted machining modules for CNC machines
High-frequency micro-vibration systems for reduced cutting force
Customized machining solutions for advanced materials
